raw_text: Next.js TS app: `src/app` routes/API; components `src/components`, hooks `src/hooks`, utilities `src/lib`, assets `public/`, scripts `scripts/`; standalone Vite: `vite-base-template/`. Commands: `npm run dev` (Turbopack :3000), `npm run build`, `npm run start`, `npm run lint`, `cd vite-base-template && npm run dev`, `npm --prefix vite-base-template run build`. TS strict/noEmit; `@/*`→`src/*`; ESLint `eslint.config.mjs` (`<REDACTED_USER>/no-explicit-any` disabled); 2 spaces; PascalCase components, camelCase vars/functions, kebab-case files. Tailwind v4. No test runner; prefer Vitest/Jest + RTL; colocate `Component.test.tsx` or `__tests__/`; cover critical paths. Commits imperative, concise, scoped. PRs: summary/rationale, local test steps/screenshots for UI, linked issues, build/lint/run checklist. Use `.env.local`; do not commit secrets. `NEXT_PUBLIC_*` client-exposed; rotate leaked credentials promptly; prefer per-env keys. `/iframe/*` rewrites to dynamic API `src/app/api/iframe`.
